title: Cap-Table Fast-Assess Sentinel
description: Marker file written by quick_assess.py to indicate that the cap-table skill ran in fast-assess mode (1-page directional answer only; no canonical JSON artifacts produced). Cross-skill consumers reading a {company_slug}-fastassess REVIEW_DIR should check for this file before treating a missing report.json as 'never ran'.

schema_version.description: Sentinel schema version. Distinct from the main cap-table report schema (v0.5.0-cap-table).

run_id.description: Run identifier (ISO-8601 timestamp with separators stripped). Unique per fast-assess invocation.

company_slug.description: Kebab-case slug derived from company_name. The REVIEW_DIR is conventionally `cap-table-{company_slug}-fastassess/`.

rule_pack_version.description: Version of cap-table-rules.json the math producers cited. Lets consumers detect rule-pack drift since sentinel was written.

components.description: Ordered list of input components the hash was computed over. Lets consumers determine 'inputs changed since fast-assess ran' and trigger a re-run.

fast_assess_report_path.description: Absolute path to the founder-facing markdown report (`report_fast_assess.md`).

produces_canonical_artifacts.description: Always false in fast-assess mode. Marker that no inputs.json / instruments.json / cap_state.json / scenarios.json / rule_audit.json / counsel_packet.json / report.json was produced.

note.description: Human-readable explanation of the fast-assess contract.

headline_data.description: Denormalized headline output for lightweight consumers (e.g., ic-sim asking about dilution exposure). Mirrors coaching_payload field names where applicable so consumers can reuse parsers.

rerun_hint.description: Human-readable instruction for getting full artifacts.
